model: auto-selected per series by backtest MASE

models.snaive: Seasonal naive — each month repeats the most recent observed value for that calendar month
models.ets: Holt-Winters — damped additive trend + multiplicative monthly seasonality, smoothing grid-searched on one-step error
models.prophet: Meta Prophet — additive trend + multiplicative yearly + country holidays + COVID 2020-21 events + GDP/capita regressor where available

selection: lowest mean MASE over the backtest folds, candidates tried simplest-first (seasonal naive, then damped ETS, then Prophet) with a 5% relative margin required to unseat a simpler model. MASE scales by the in-sample seasonal-naive MAE, so it stays finite on series that approach zero — which MAPE does not, and why MAPE is published but never decides.
backtest: rolling-origin, up to 3 folds x 12mo holdouts; every candidate scored on identical folds; 80% interval coverage measured on the same held-out months
bands: each candidate's raw interval is rescaled by the 80th percentile of its held-out error measured in units of its own band half-width, clamped to [0.25, 4.0]. Raw coverage of a nominal 80% band ran at a median 39% for Prophet and 100% for the seasonal naive, so the label was wrong in both directions. `coverage` stays the raw out-of-sample number; `coverage_cal` is the scaled band on the same months and is therefore in-sample. Applied to the forward forecast only - the shipped backtest rows keep the band the model actually claimed.
note: Short-term forecasts. Fit nightly by .github/workflows/refresh-data.yml on the real observed series. Per-airport output lives in data/forecasts/<IATA>.json, fetched by the browser once that gateway is selected; each metric carries the chosen model at the top level plus every candidate's scores (and the alternatives' forecasts) under `candidates`, which is what the model toggle in the UI switches between. This file only carries the shared model metadata.
